[b][color=white]Trump Administration Considers Moves to Bolster Economy[/color][/b][/size][/font]
[align=justify]With fears of a possible recession mounting, the Trump administration is taking steps to prop up the economy in preparation. Some of the proposals put forward include a payroll tax cut, which is touted to boost the economy by allowing workers to take larger paychecks home, as well as rolling back some of President Trump’s tax cuts. Even though the president insists the economy is doing well, contingency plans are being put together in case the economy cannot hold a recession at bay. The payroll tax cut needs congressional approval, which advisers see as possible because similar interventions were taken during the Obama administration. [i][size=x-small][url=https://www.nytimes.com/2019/08/19/business/trump-economy.html]>>Source[/url][/size][/i][/align]
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=medium]

[b][color=white]U.S. home sales rise, boosted by lower mortgage rates[/color][/b][/size][/font]
[align=justify]Despite the common consensus among U.S economists of a global economic slowdown, the U.S home market registered a 2.5% uptick in home sales in July of 2019. The Federal Reserve is mostly to thank for this growth as it decreased interest rates on home sales in July. The home sale marker was weary in December after the Federal Reserve raised these rates, but its reversal is giving hope to the National Association of Realtors. The cut in interest rate is interesting because it came at a time when unemployment is at its lowest level in almost 50 years, with the estimated unemployment numbers predicted to be more likely to cause an increase in interest rates and therefore a slowdown in home sales and purchases. [i][size=x-small][url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-economy-housing/u-s-home-sales-rise-boosted-by-lower-mortgage-rates-idUSKCN1VB1MC]>>Source[/url][/size][/i][/align]
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=medium]

[b][color=white]Report shows US deficit to exceed $1 trillion next year[/color][/b][/size][/font]
[align=justify]Taking into account the big budget deal enacted by President Trump this summer, the federal budget deficit is projected to grow to over $1 trillion in the next fiscal year. Experts are now warning that the federal debt, which is already untannable in is historical context, is heading towards unsustainable levels. All this is despite President Trump campaigning on the pledge to balance the budget and bring the federal deficit down. CBO, a nonpartisan group, forecasts that the deficit for this fiscal year will exceed $960 billion, with the number growing past the projected $12 trillion in the next one. The group also warned that the deficit is set to grow higher, especially on the realization that the U.S population is aging, which will increase healthcare costs in the coming decade. [i][size=x-small][url=https://www.apnews.com/f26c8c00b2eb4f98b84cd6921cca2fdb]>>Source[/url][/size][/i]
[/align]

[b][color=white]Bad Boys For Life Trailer[/color][/b] 
There is a new Bad Boys movie coming out soon; it is the third movie in the franchise. Bad Boy For Life, Will Smith will be returning to play in this movie. The movie looks like it will have lots of action and comedy in it. Unlike the other two movies, This movie is not directed by Michael Bay, but rather by Adil El Arbi and Bilall Fallah. Regardless of whoever directed this film, I still think it will turn out to be just as great as the last two.
I'm looking forward to seeing this movie once it comes out on January 17, 2020.  [i][size=x-small][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KhwsKvoiCpQ]>>Source[/url][/size][/i]

[b][color=white]Nintendo Switch Lite Unboxing[/color][/b] 
If you haven't heard of the Switch Lite, it is the all new handheld-only Nintendo console. It has been created as a cheaper alternative to the original Nintendo Switch. The price is significantly cheaper, but it is still able to play most of the games for the Nintendo Switch. In this video, YouTuber Kevin Kenson has managed to snag one of these babies before the official release date, which is set to be released on September 20, 2019. For those who are on a tight budget but still wanna play Switch games, perhaps this may be the right choice for you. [i][size=x-small][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ANsdse5b_dg]>>Source[/url][/size][/i]

[b][color=white]Battle At Big Rock Short Film[/color][/b] 
Jurassic World has recently released an all-new short film on YouTube titled "Battle at Big Rock." It is only a short 8-minute film, but it feels as if you were watching a scene from a full blown Jurassic Park movie. I feel like they did very well with this short film, and perhaps this could be a clue to a possible new future Jurassic World film. I was always a fan of the Jurassic Park movies. [i][size=x-small][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C7kbVvpOGdQ]>>Source[/url][/size][/i]

[b][color=#ccffff]Horoscopes[/color][/b] / [i]Sep 16, 2019 - Sep 22, 2019[/i]
[spoiler][/size][/font]
[list]
[*][b][color=#cc3333]Aries ♈[/color][/b]
[i]"If you have noticed delays to your ambitions and career plans, things can begin to ease from this week as cautious Saturn turns direct in a more prominent zone. It may not happen right away, but gradually you’ll begin to notice positive change. 

 However, you could feel quite strongly about one goal, especially around Thursday when feisty Mars aligns with potent Pluto. You may be determined to make it happen, come what may. But be sure you want your prize once you have it. 

 Activities this week can be fueled by a dreamy influence between jovial Jupiter and hazy Neptune, which could give you unrealistic expectations. You will do better to keep your feet on the ground, because all that glitters is not necessarily gold.
